posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina delighted fans with her May photo dump featuring baby Vihaan's tiny hands, cozy moments with Vicky Kaushal, and a sweet birthday picnic for 'Papa.'

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's film Main Vaapas Aaunga with AR Rahman and Imtiaz Ali releases June 12, while his AURA Tour 2026 continues after making history with two sold-out Madison Square Garden nights.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's spy thriller Alpha with Sharvari has been preponed to July 3. She plays an assassin raised to kill in YRF's edgy origin story that Bobby Deol calls groundbreaking.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is shooting SS Rajamouli's mega-budget Ugrabhatti in Hyderabad, while also gearing up for Mira Nair's Amri with Jaideep Ahlawat and a survival thriller Reset with Orlando Bloom.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK stepped back from a Jailer 2 cameo to focus on King, his action thriller with Siddharth Anand. His new Visa ad has fans convinced it's a secret King teaser ahead of the Christmas 2026 release.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena wrapped filming on Meghna Gulzar's Daayra with Prithviraj Sukumaran. She's also in talks for Salman Khan's superhero film directed by Raj & DK, with casting set to begin in June.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha reportedly sustained a fracture while shooting for Eetha, halting production. She recently praised rumored partner Rahul Mody as 'gifted' amid ongoing relationship buzz.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announced her second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh while juggling King with SRK and Allu Arjun's Raka, where a body double will handle action sequences to prioritize her health.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's Don 3 exit sparked major industry drama with FWICE issuing then withdrawing a non-cooperation directive. His Dhurandhar franchise heads to Japan with ₹1,307 crore already banked globally.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya and daughter Aaradhya continue to serve mother-daughter goals, twinning in black outfits at Mumbai airport after turning heads at Paris Fashion Week and the Cannes Film Festival.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Newlywed Rashmika is promoting Cocktail 2 (releasing June 19) with playful BTS teases, while husband Vijay Deverakonda celebrated his 37th birthday with fans at their Hyderabad home.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha revealed Sai Pallavi was the first choice for her upcoming action comedy Maa Inti Bangaaram. The film, co-produced under her Tralala banner, marks her reunion with Oh! Baby director Nandini Reddy.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's next big project Raka with director Atlee and Deepika Padukone is generating massive buzz, with the production adapting its shoot schedule around Deepika's second pregnancy.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi is a box office storm — crossing ₹150 crore in days after its June 4 release. Daughter Klin Kaara's sweet voice message for 'Nanna' went viral as the sports drama dominates screens.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon with Prashanth Neel dropped its first glimpse showing a rugged avatar, while he reportedly halted the shoot for a major overhaul. The NA/UK theatrical deal locked at ₹55 crore.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is at the center of a Peddi controversy as viewers called out the hypersexualization of her character Achiyyamma. Director Buchi Babu Sana issued an apology and promised edits to 'concerned portions.'

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya bought a swanky new home in Mumbai and turned heads at a recent event in a stunning all-white ethnic look with pearl detailing, bindi, and flowers in her hair.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara plays the female lead in War 2 alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR, slated for August 14 release. She stole the spotlight at NMACC's anniversary event in a stunning pink saree with Sidharth Malhotra.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik called Jr NTR 'simply amazing' as War 2 wraps its epic dance-off sequence. The YRF spy thriller targets August 14 and promises to be bigger than the 2019 original.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai opened strong at ₹8.5 crore on Day 1. Kriti Sanon's surprise cameo gave fans the 'perfect Bhediya reunion' they were waiting for.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal continues her concert tour across US cities including upcoming shows in multiple metros. Her voice remains one of Bollywood's most sought-after for chartbusting soundtracks.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman's score for Ram Charan's Peddi is being praised as a highlight of the ₹350 crore sports drama. He also composed the soulful 'Ishq Mastana' for Diljit Dosanjh's Main Vaapas Aaunga.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's farewell film Jananayagan is targeting a summer release window after Tamil Nadu elections wrapped up. His political party TVK has emerged as a serious force in state politics.
